title: narcissus bulbocodium subsp. citrinus
intro: Narcissus bulbocodium subsp. citrinus, commonly known as the Citrus Daffodil or the Jonquil, is a type of perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its fragrance and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and its potential to reduce stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus bulbocodium subsp. citrinus include its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine and lycorine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat a range of health conditions.
